title.zh-CN: 请检查历史部署的 JWT 密钥
title.en: Check JWT secrets in existing deployments

content.zh-CN:
历史 Docker Compose 模板（包括一键脚本生成的模板）及 .env 示例曾包含固定占位值 change-me-to-a-random-string。全新一键安装通常会生成随机密钥，并非所有旧安装都受影响；手动部署、沿用旧 .env 或旧模板的管理员请自行检查。

请只在服务器本地核对部署目录 .env 中的 JWT_SECRET 和实际启动配置，不要将密钥发到工单、群聊或截图中。若仍使用公开占位值、示例密钥或弱口令，请备份配置，运行 openssl rand -hex 32 生成独立随机值，更新实际使用的 JWT_SECRET。Docker 部署需使用原有项目、环境文件和数据卷重新创建容器（仅 restart 不会更新容器环境变量）；本地部署重启面板。不要删除数据库或数据卷。

新版本会拒绝已知占位值和明显弱密钥并持久生成替代密钥，但升级保留已有自定义配置，不代表旧环境文件已被清理。已使用独立强随机密钥的用户无需更改。更换实际签名密钥会使已有登录及绑定验证失效，需要重新登录；请在维护窗口操作。详见项目部署文档中的“升级和备份 → 历史 JWT 密钥检查”。
content.en:
Historical Docker Compose templates, including templates generated by the one-click installer, and the .env example contained the shared placeholder change-me-to-a-random-string. Fresh one-click installations normally generated random secrets, so not every old installation is affected. Administrators who deployed manually or reused old .env files or templates should check their configuration.

Inspect JWT_SECRET in the deployment .env and the actual startup configuration locally on the server. Never share the secret in tickets, chats or screenshots. If it is a public placeholder, example secret or weak password, back up the configuration, generate a unique random value with openssl rand -hex 32, and update the JWT_SECRET actually used at startup. For Docker, recreate the container using the same project, environment file and data volumes: restart alone does not refresh container environment variables. For local deployments, restart the panel. Do not delete the database or volumes.

Newer versions reject known placeholders and obviously weak secrets and persist a generated replacement. However, upgrades preserve custom configuration and do not guarantee old environment files were cleaned up. No change is needed if you already use a unique strong random secret. Changing the effective signing secret invalidates existing logins and binding verifications; sign in again afterward and perform the change during maintenance. See the deployment guide: Upgrade and backup → Historical JWT secret check.
